grid_refinement.criteria: Same measured geometry, material inputs, camera coefficients, nominal probe, wall section, channel sets, profile window, detector response, and isolated-shape width observer; only the periodic-equilibrium grid N is doubled.

profile_transform.camera_normalization: For each disk, divide measured counts by their peak-to-peak range on the existing support outside the three wall sectors. Camera coefficients are least-squares fit to the fixed three-star compact field on that same non-wall support.
profile_transform.measurement: Average linear-interpolated integrated-disk intensity across the three established cuts at longitudinal chord fractions 0.42, 0.50, and 0.58.
profile_transform.model_observation: Apply the existing detector intensity law, 5-point Gauss-Hermite quadrature along the wall, and the nominal Gaussian probe across the wall; then apply the same profile detrend and L2 normalization.
profile_transform.profile_shape: On the retained geometry-limited profile window, remove a least-squares linear baseline independently for each disk, then divide by that channel's L2 norm. No sign flip or amplitude fit is applied. Plot one deterministic highest-contrast retained channel per ring, rescaled to unit L2 norm; the archived scores use all retained channels.

first_ring_image.display_note: Raw integrated counts from the selected first-ring disk; crop and color stretch are for display only.
first_ring_image.midpoint_cut_display_note: Full midpoint cut and its physical distance coordinate are stored; the red plotted segment uses only indices within the retained profile window.

first.representative_channel_selection: Largest detrended measured-profile L2 amplitude among the established retained channels for this ring.

second.representative_channel_selection: Largest detrended measured-profile L2 amplitude among the established retained channels for this ring.

scope: Two selected real MoS2 comparison walls: DS14 and DS10, one chord per scan, nominal 1.25 nm probe. No scan-wide fit, new contrast selection, parameter tuning, or additional equilibrium sweep.

selection.primary_population: Exactly the 243 comparison-map chords whose separate first- and second-ring fits qualify at all three assumed probe FWHM values (0.75, 1.25, 1.75 nm).
selection.rule: Divide the ten comparison scans into the existing lower-twist (<0.8 deg) and higher-twist (>=1.18 deg) groups. Choose the scan nearest the group's median inferred twist; ties use the larger qualified-chord count, then scan ID. Within that scan choose the qualified chord nearest the scan's median signed first-minus-second apparent-width gap; ties use the sorted first-ring center indices.
